description: Top 20% of non-financial long-term candidates by sector-neutral value (value_sn), equal-weighted, rebalanced monthly. The bottom 30% by 60-day median TL volume is dropped before ranking.

forward_record.evaluation: scripts/forward_record_report.py: next-close fills, 1M TL, base costs (core/portfolio_backtest.py)

change_policy: Any change to params needs a new pre-registration and a new version. A new version starts a new forward series; earlier decisions are never re-simulated under the new rule.

expectation.source: docs/research/first_published_panel.md (costed P0 holdout 2021-01..2026-08, 1M TL, base costs, vs gross EW universe, point-in-time panel)
expectation.rule: z = (sum of monthly active - n x mean) / (sigma_eff x sqrt(n)), sigma_eff = mean x sqrt(months) / nw_t. z < -2 = record inconsistent with the backtest.

data_fixes.what: TTM flows from 2023Q4 use vendor-consistent YTD formula (pit_panel.vendor_consistent_ttm); İş Yatırım re-expresses prior-year periods
